rules.decision: Certify only after direct side-by-side comparison finds no material visitor-planning gaps versus the institution's published visitor guidance, the TexasDefined guide adds independent visitor value, specific exhibit highlights are accurate and brief, the FAQ is researched beyond the operator's FAQ and photos/links/technical QA pass.
